Drag to orbit. Each grid square is one tile; the original truck and horse stay at native scale. The survivable site shows a SAM strike to the tail, crushed skids, a broken rotor and an open cabin exit. Light painted smoke drifts from the engine; toggle or pause it to inspect the airframe. Grey forms hide the smoke. The squad can begin its story beside the aircraft. These are static airframes with a smoke effect; the opening cinematic, survivor spawning and gameplay passage are not wired yet. Reference sheet ↗ · Paint sheet ↗
